request.prompt: Paint a new Age of Empires III unit portrait in exactly the painting style of the first two reference images (official Age of Empires III unit portraits): close-up of head and shoulders, the head large in the upper half, three-quarter view, smooth airbrushed painterly skin, simplified stylised forms and folds, soft warm key light, hand-painted video-game look, NOT a photograph. The third image is only a costume reference (a low-poly game model), not a style reference. Subject: a Joseon Korean archer of the late 16th century, a man of about 28 with masculine East Asian features, a thin black moustache, focused calm look. He wears a conical Korean steel helmet with a dark mail neck guard covering the neck and ears; a long military coat with broad black edging along the collar and shoulders; white sleeves. The coat cloth is one flat pure magenta colour (#FF00FF) with no shading; the black edging and the white sleeves stay on top of it. He holds a short, strongly recurved Korean horn bow (gakgung, dark horn and birch bark, curled tips) in his left hand, and fletched arrows show from a quiver behind his shoulder. Background: flat pure green (#00FF00), nothing else. No text, no border.
